formula_source: Qi (2025), Eq. (2), (6)-(8), supplemented by Qi and Hu (2023), Eq. (2)-(7) and complete weighted state equation Eq. (11)
interpretation: The stochastic OU state and neighbor term are removed for the crisp baseline. Signed directions are simulation conventions. Both bordering lane-mark contributions are summed as stated in Qi and Hu (2023). Explicit eta coefficients replace the former L_ref/t_ref normalization.

a_max_x.source_detail: Representative diagnostic value, not paper calibration.

a_idm.source_detail: Kept separate from a_max_x despite equal diagnostic values.

b_idm.source_detail: Representative diagnostic value, not paper calibration.

desired_speed.source_detail: Representative diagnostic value, not paper calibration.

minimum_spacing.source_detail: Representative diagnostic value, not paper calibration.

time_headway.source_detail: Center value of the configured triangular fuzzy number T~=(1.2,1.5,1.8) s; not paper calibration.

gamma.source_detail: Qi and Hu (2023), Section 5.1 case-study value.

zeta.source_detail: Center value of the configured triangular fuzzy number zeta~=(0.8,1.0,1.2) 1/m; Qi and Hu (2023) case study used beta=3.6.

epsilon.source_detail: Qi and Hu (2023) used alpha=0.1; corresponds by formula shape to epsilon.

eta_middle.source_detail: Qi and Hu (2023) used eta_u=1.0; the SI unit is made explicit here to close the acceleration dimension.

eta_boundary.source_detail: Qi and Hu (2023) used eta_bnd=1.0; the paper did not separately discuss dimensional units.

eta_mark.source_detail: Qi and Hu (2023) used eta_mk=1.0; the paper did not separately discuss dimensional units.

boundary_left.source_detail: Physical road edge located 0.05 m outside the painted edge line; y increases to the right.

boundary_right.source_detail: Physical road edge located 0.05 m outside the painted edge line; y increases to the right.

markings.source_detail: Two internal lane dividers and two painted road-edge lines; the rightmost target lane is bounded by marks at 1.75 and 5.25 m.

lane_center.source_detail: Target center of the rightmost lane, selected so the road-boundary force can be observed without changing the road geometry.

alpha_boundary.source_detail: Corresponds by formula shape to epsilon in Qi (2025).

beta_lane_mark.source_detail: Corresponds by formula shape to zeta in Qi (2025).

eta_u.source_detail: Case-study coefficient; strict SI unit not discussed.

eta_boundary.source_detail: Case-study coefficient; strict SI unit not discussed.

eta_mark.source_detail: Case-study coefficient; strict SI unit not discussed.

offsets.source_detail: The fuzzy run uses +1.0 m relative to the rightmost-lane center, giving y(0)=4.5 m and a 0.80 m distance to the right physical road boundary. Initial states remain crisp, not fuzzy.

following_duration.source_detail: Normal following only runs after the declared recovery gate passes.

method.source_detail: Classical RK4 applied to the smooth two-mark sum baseline.

dt.source_detail: Our numerical choice, not paper step size.

dt_comparison.source_detail: Compare entire trajectories at shared times.

tail_position_tolerance.source_detail: Diagnostic recovery tolerance, not safety or calibrated driving criterion.

tail_speed_tolerance.source_detail: Diagnostic tolerance, not measured driver performance.

step_position_tolerance.source_detail: Max whole-time difference for dt=.05 versus .025.

step_speed_tolerance.source_detail: Max whole-time difference for dt=.05 versus .025.

absolute_ay_limit.source_detail: Numerical explosion screen only; not a road safety or comfort threshold.

final_center_tolerance.source_detail: Numerical recovery gate for every sampled fuzzy trajectory at the final time; not a calibrated driving criterion.

final_lateral_speed_tolerance.source_detail: Numerical recovery gate for every sampled fuzzy trajectory at the final time; not a calibrated driving criterion.

time_headway.source_detail: Representative ±20% support for the first numerical fuzzy experiment; not paper calibration.

zeta.source_detail: Representative support chosen after deterministic sensitivity diagnosis; not paper calibration.
